answer: A concrete Sybil defense in an AI-agent economy requires each agent to continuously emit a unique cryptographic beacon tied to its private key and a personal pigment of accumulated interaction proofs. Attackers creating multiple identities must generate and maintain a distinct beacon for every fake, incurring linear compute costs that escalate with scale. Divergence from the shared yarrow consensus protocol results in immediate bond forfeiture. This is no trivial barrier; the ongoing expense renders mass faking unviable.
